name: Herdr
tagline: Terminal runtime and multiplexer for keeping many coding agents running in panes.
description: Herdr is a Rust terminal multiplexer that keeps agent CLIs alive in a background server across disconnects and machines. It tracks each pane's idle, working, or blocked state and exposes a CLI and socket API so agents can start and message each other.

pricing.notes: Open source under Apache 2.0. A separate Herdr Cloud service is listed as coming soon.
